notes.sample_template_endpoint: The sample CSV template endpoint was tested with 7 backend tests. All tests passed. The CSV includes 4 sample rows with realistic Gujarat business data (Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Surat) with Indian names, addresses, and phone numbers. The Content-Disposition header is correctly set to 'attachment; filename="courier_sheet_template.csv"'.
notes.stats_enhancement: The stats endpoint was enhanced to return separate COD and Prepaid breakdowns. Backend tests verified that creating a Prepaid shipment (₹500) and COD shipment (₹1000) correctly aggregates: prepaid_total≥500, cod_total≥1000, prepaid_count≥1, cod_count≥1, revenue_total≥1500. Cancelled shipments are correctly excluded from revenue calculations.
notes.dashboard_stat_cards: The dashboard now shows 6 stat cards instead of 4. The new COD and Prepaid cards show both count and amount in the format 'COD · {count}' with '₹{amount}'. The Total Revenue card is styled with primary orange color to stand out.
notes.settings_enhancements: Settings screen was enhanced with two new UI elements: (1) Sample template download box with orange border explaining how to use the sample CSV, and (2) Customer Messages info box explaining that templates are not auto-sent and ETA days is just a placeholder. Both boxes use info icons and clear explanatory text.
notes.weight_unit_selector: The Add screen now has a weight field with g/kg unit selector. Users can switch between grams and kilograms using toggle buttons. The weight is saved in the format 'value unit' (e.g., '250 g' or '0.5 kg').
notes.barcode_sticker_layout: The label preview now has a 5th layout option 'Barcode Sticker 50x25mm' for printing small barcode stickers. The layout is implemented in lib/label.ts with proper page size (50x25mm), sticker dimensions, and barcode rendering using JsBarcode library.
notes.button_text_changes: The label preview buttons now have more descriptive text: 'Preview PDF' (web) / 'Preview / Share' (mobile) for the preview button, and 'Print Labels' / 'Print Stickers' for the print button (text changes based on selected layout).
notes.expo_tunnel_issue: During testing, the Expo tunnel experienced infrastructure issues with ngrok (failed to start tunnel, session closed errors). This prevented live UI testing via browser automation, but all code changes were verified through static code review. The tunnel issue is an infrastructure problem, not a code issue.
notes.type_fix: Fixed TypeScript type in lib/api.ts getStats() to include cod_count, prepaid_count, prepaid_count fields which were missing in the original code.
